title: A token issued through the MCP saves Claude assets and is refused everywhere else, the relay included

tasks.title: Tokens marked via mcp accepted only on the two asset write routes, refused by the relay

acs.text: WHEN a request to `POST /api/v1/claude-assets` or `POST /api/v1/claude-assets/import` carries a valid token with `via: "mcp"` THE SYSTEM SHALL handle it as the token's user, as it does an unmarked token
scenarios: AC-001 the two asset write routes accept a marked token

acs.text: WHEN a request to any other route that needs a user carries a valid token with `via: "mcp"` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 403 `auth.mcp_not_allowed` before reading the body or doing anything; the set of routes that accept such a token SHALL be exactly the two of AC-001, checked against every route the server serves
scenarios: AC-002 every other route refuses a marked token

acs.text: WHEN a token carries a `via` claim with any other value THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse it as invalid (401 `auth.invalid_token`)
scenarios: AC-003 any other via value is an invalid token

acs.text: WHEN a socket offers the relay a token that carries a `via` claim THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse it with 401, as it refuses any invalid token
scenarios: AC-004 the relay refuses a marked token

acs.text: WHEN an endpoint is declared to accept MCP tokens without being on the reviewed list THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse to load it, the way a public endpoint off the public list is refused
scenarios: AC-005 the list of routes that take a marked token is reviewed
